description: Returns which credentials this MCP currently has cached (JWT, API key, smart-account session key) and when each expires. For an unexpired JWT it also asks the API whether the sign-in is still accepted: jwt.server is accepted, sign_in_revoked (signed out everywhere), sign_in_expired, sign_in_invalid, or unverified when the API could not be reached, and jwt.fresh is false once the API refuses it. Read-only. Always safe to call.
name: auth_status
title: Inspect cached credentials
